A '''Control Cube''' (Japanese: '''コントロールキューブ''' ''Control Cube'') is an item present in [[Detective Pikachu Returns]] that was created by [[Unitas]] in order to control Pokémon behavior.

==Overview==
[[File:Detective Pikachu Returns cube controller.png|thumb|200px|A cube controller.]]
Control Cubes were commissioned by mayor [[Howard Myers]] as part of the [[Unitas]] project in an effort to improve harmony and coexistence between people and Pokémon. However, under the direction of [[Charles Merloch]], the cubes were developed and used as items to control Pokémon and deprive them of their free will.

A Control Cube functions when placed on a Pokémon's back, and an external controller can be used to activate the cube. An activated cube will glow purple, and the Pokémon will be in complete control by the user of the device. These cubes were used in multiple crimes in [[Detective Pikachu Returns]], including the theft of the Aurora Drop, framing of innocent Pokémon by the Pokémon Protection Bureau, and the detainment of multiple Pokémon in the [[Pokémon Unity Lab]]. 

When deactivated, the Pokémon will have no memory of the events that occurred while the Control Cube was active. Pokémon affected by these cubes are negatively experienced from its use, including extreme fatigue and irregular fluctuations in brain waves. 

The Control Cubes were planned to be announced by Howard Myers as '''Friendship Cubes''' at the end of Pokémon Friendship Week, before [[Tim Goodman|Tim]], [[Detective Pikachu (character)|Pikachu]], and [[Rachel Myers|Rachel]] convince the mayor of the cubes' actual intentions.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Earlier prototypes of the Control Cube were not effective on {{type|Rock}} Pokémon.
